items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: It's like Dave [Higgins] would say, 'Man, you know, you're the first cat to play the avantgarde.'

ctx.x: You know? Monk come back in, boom. We know where he's at. We had one chord and we was right back into the thing. That's so far as avantgarde -- I used to kind of run from them. The cats would say, 'Man, you play avantgarde.' It's like Dave [Higgins] would say, 'Man, you know, you're the first cat to play the avantgarde.' I wondered about that. I said, 'What are you talking about?' I didn't look at it like that. I didn't even know the meaning of the word, 'avantgarde.'
But that seems to have gone under now.
